summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the 3D portfolio (React + three.js/react-three-fiber). All primary flows verified via Playwright at 1920x800: hero + navbar render, laptop lid opens on scroll and reveals the login screen on-screen, login form (email/password/submit) works and swaps to the welcome screen with sonner toast, 3D books are clickable via canvas raycast and open the correct side panels (memes/creativity confirmed opening; visual screenshot confirms all 4 spines: MEME BOOK, CINEMATOGRAPHY, CREATIVITY, SKILL LEARNING), Projects list renders 4 rows and clicking project-row-01 smooth-scrolls back to the laptop and displays the ProjectPreview (Orbital Commerce with tags + glow) on the laptop screen, contact-email-link + 4 social links render at the bottom. Login screen shows ZERO vertical drift when scrolling (bounding box delta = 0.0px, confirming the position:fixed 3D stage fix). No console errors, no React crashes.

integration_issues.flow: Project preview close → return to login
integration_issues.issue: After clicking project-preview-close-button, laptop-login-screen was not detected in the DOM within 1.5s. This may be a timing artifact (Lenis damped animations + lid re-animation) rather than a real bug, since the ScreenLogin component is unconditionally rendered when activeProject is null. Worth a quick manual double-check by main agent, but not blocking.

action_items: Optional: verify that after ProjectPreview close, the login screen becomes fully visible/interactive without needing an additional scroll nudge (small polish, low priority).
critical_code_review_comments: Books.js/Book component: `document.body.style.cursor` is mutated directly on hover in/out. If a book is unmounted while hovered, cursor may stick as 'pointer'. Consider resetting on unmount.
Laptop.js: screenHtmlRef.current.style.opacity is set to a number without unit — works in most browsers but a string like `${vis}` would be safer.

ScreenLogin state (`unlocked`) is component-local, so navigating to a project and back resets the welcome-screen state on remount. If this is intentional (fresh login each visit) it's fine; otherwise lift the state to LaptopSection.
No offline/no-JS fallback for the 3D scene — acceptable for a portfolio, worth noting.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows passed; only a minor timing observation on project→login return)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use viewport 1920x800. Wait ~3s after scrolls because Lenis is heavily damped (lerp 0.09). Machine section is 350vh starting after 100vh hero; scroll to window.innerHeight*2.6 to see login screen. Books raycast area at (1200-1400, 400-550). Console had zero errors during full traversal. Login drift test PASSED (0px delta).
